Bagged trees via ipred

Source: R/bag_tree-rpart.R
bagging_surv_train.Rd

bagging_surv_train() is a wrapper for the bagging() function in the ipred package that passes the main arguments for the trees on to rpart::rpart.control().

Usage

bagging_surv_train(
  formula,
  data,
  maxdepth = NULL,
  minsplit = NULL,
  cp = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

formula

A symbolic description of the model to be fitted.

data

A data frame containing the variables in the model.

maxdepth

The maximum depth of any node of the final tree.

minsplit

The minimum number of observations in a node in order for a split to be attempted.

cp

The complexity parameter.

...

Other arguments to pass to rpart::rpart.control() or ipred::bagging(), matched by name.

Value

A fitted bagging model.

Details

Arguments for rpart::rpart.control() which are not set take their default values from ipred, or from a control object if one is passed via .... The main arguments and other rpart::rpart.control() arguments passed via ... take precedence over a control object.

Examples

bagging_surv_train(Surv(time, status) ~ age + ph.ecog, data = lung, maxdepth = 2)
#> 
#> Bagging survival trees with 25 bootstrap replications 
#> 
#> Call: bagging.data.frame(formula = formula, data = data, control = control)
#> 
#>
